_comment: Paste into 'SLA Thresholds ms (JSON)' field. Keys are URL regex patterns, values are max allowed ms.

_tuning_guide.DEV: Relax SLAs — infra is shared and slow. Use 2x PROD values.
_tuning_guide.QA: Moderate. Match PROD SLAs or add 20% buffer.
_tuning_guide.PROD: Strict. Use actual SLA from your API contract / SLO doc.
